title: The Maharashtra Restoration of Lands to Scheduled Tribes Act, 1974

Ministry: Ministry of Govt of Maharashtra Department: Revenue & Forest Department Type: STATE Location: Maharashtra TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles The Maharashtra Restoration of Lands to Scheduled Tribes Act, 1974 Show all section Section 1. Short title, extent and commencement. Section 2. Definitions. Section 3. Restoration of transfer of lands to Tribals in certain cases. Section 4. Restoration of lands of persons belonging to Scheduled Tribes. Section 5. Damages for occupation of land in certain cases. Section 5A. Lands which cannot be restored to vest in Government and to be granted to other Tribal subject to certain restrictions. Section 6. Appeal. Section 7. Revision. Section 8. Court-fee. Section 9.
